claim: For the 12-point Euclidean cuboctahedron \(C=\{(x_1,x_2,x_3)\in\{0,\pm1\}^3:\text{ exactly one coordinate is }0\}\) with the Euclidean metric, the inclusive Vietoris--Rips complexes satisfy \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq\bigvee^{11}S^0\) for \(0\le r<\sqrt2\), \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq\bigvee^{5}S^1\) for \(\sqrt2\le r<2\), \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq S^2\) for \(2\le r<\sqrt6\), \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq S^5\) for \(\sqrt6\le r<2\sqrt2\), and \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\) is contractible for \(r\ge2\sqrt2\).

correctness.rationale: All pairwise distances are classified exactly. The proof makes no inference from finite sampling to an infinite statement.
